scenario: Omar Diriye is designed as having been stopped after a minor parking-area collision. At custody he attempted breath samples. Operator entries, device printouts and audio differ on the number and timing of attempts. D1 reported respiratory symptoms; a custody assessment is brief. The Magistrates' Court design records conviction and disqualification. A notice of appeal is filed after an address/service problem, with an extension explanation. A respiratory expert is later instructed for a Crown Court rehearing. No charge, excuse, appeal or outcome is decided.
